title: Critique visual hierarchy
description: Review reading order, grouping, spacing, typography and competing emphasis.
accomplishes: Review reading order, grouping, spacing, typography and competing emphasis. Distinguish visible evidence from interpretation. Recommend a short ordered set of changes with reasons and a method for testing task comprehension, rather than redesigning everything.
prompt:
Act as a senior product designer.

Task: Critique visual hierarchy.

Input context:
- SCREEN: [SCREEN]
- USER TASK: [USER TASK]
- KNOWN CONSTRAINTS: [KNOWN CONSTRAINTS]

Review reading order, grouping, spacing, typography and competing emphasis. Distinguish visible evidence from interpretation. Recommend a short ordered set of changes with reasons and a method for testing task comprehension, rather than redesigning everything.

Make the output practical, reviewable and appropriate to the supplied context.

Use English for explanations unless the task or user explicitly requires another language. Use clear sections and a format suited to the deliverable. If essential information is missing, ask a focused question before concluding. Label assumptions and unknowns. Do not invent facts, sources, results or completed checks. End with verification criteria and remaining limitations.
exampleResult:
## Hypothetical resource page
The heading competes with three coloured badges and a large secondary panel. Reduce badge emphasis, group metadata and move the primary action closer to the description. Keep text relationships consistent at smaller widths. Ask readers to identify the page purpose and next action before and after the proposed change. No user-test result is claimed.
